def maximal_rects(g):
    H,W=g.shape
    res=set()
    for c in range(10):
        m=(g==c)
        # integral approach: for each top-left, extend while uniform, then check maximality
        for y in range(H):
            for x in range(W):
                if not m[y,x]: continue
                if y>0 and m[y-1,x]: continue  # not top of a rect
                if x>0 and m[y,x-1]: continue
                # expand
                wmax=0
                while x+wmax<W and m[y,x+wmax]: wmax+=1
                h=1
                while y+h<H and all(m[y+h,x:x+wmax]): h+=1
                # this finds largest rect anchored at (y,x) with full top row; may not be all maximal rects but ok
                # check maximality: cannot extend up/left/right/down
                up = y>0 and all(m[y-1,x:x+wmax])
                left = x>0 and all(m[y:y+h,x-1])
                right = x+wmax<W and all(m[y:y+h,x+wmax])
                down = y+h<H and all(m[y+h,x:x+wmax])
                if not(up or left or right or down) and h>=3 and wmax>=3:
                    res.add((y,y+h-1,x,x+wmax-1,h,wmax,c))
    return res
